data.name: Basile
data.gender_notes: Basile is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'basileus', meaning 'king' or 'ruler'. In Greek mythology, Basile was a name given to several gods and heroes, symbolizing power and sovereignty. The name Basile carries the meaning “King, Ruler, Master” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Basile usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler, master and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Basile belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “King, Ruler, Master.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basile total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: בסילי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בסילי מקורו במילה היוונית Βασιλεύς (Basileus), שפירושה מלך או שליט. הוא קשור למילה העברית 'בסיל', שפירושה פקיד גדול או נגיד. השם נמצא בשימוש במסורת הנוצרית והוא קשור לתואר המלכותי של ישוע המשיח.

in_greek.name: Βασιλεί
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βασιλεί προέρχεται από το ελληνικό Βασιλεύς (Basileus), που σημαίνει βασιλιάς ή μονάρχης. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο τίτλος Βασιλεύς χρησιμοποιείται για να περιγράψει τον Θεό και τον Ιησού Χριστό ως τον Βασιλιά του Ουρανού και της Γης. Το όνομα έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία από τους πρώτους χρόνους και συμβολίζει την πνευματική βασιλεία.

in_latin.name: Basile
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Basile derivatur ex voce Graeca Βασιλεύς (Basileus), quae significat regem vel principem. In traditione Christiana, nomen hoc ad dignitatem regiam Iesu Christi refertur. Etymologia Latina est 'Rex' vel 'princeps', quae potestatem et auctoritatem divinam indicat.

in_english.name: Basile
in_english.long_meaning: The name Basile originates from the Greek Βασιλεύς (Basileus), meaning king or ruler. It is associated with the royal title of Jesus Christ, symbolizing spiritual kingship. The name has been used in Christian tradition since early times, signifying power, authority, and divine leadership. It connotes a sense of majesty and grandeur.

data.cultural_impact: The name Basile carries a strong cultural significance in Greek and Christian traditions. The name reflects a sense of leadership, power, and authority. In the Christian context, the name could be seen as a reminder of God's kingship and sovereignty over our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Basile lies in its reflection of God's kingly nature. As believers, we acknowledge God as the ultimate King and Ruler of our lives. The name Basile can serve as a daily reminder of our allegiance to God and the importance of submitting to His rule and guidance. It can also inspire us to strive for excellence and leadership qualities, as we seek to emulate the loving and just nature of our heavenly Father.
